messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Vestigial tests in develop?
parts:
Currently 

make test/math/error_handling/matrix/check_cholesky_factor_corr

no longer builds.  Looking at the source, check_cholesky_factor_corr passes a row vector to check_unit_vector, but check_unit_vector only takes column vectors.  This means this is a real bug in check_cholesky_factor_corr.

That said, it looks like the src/test/math directory is on its way out (in fact, I don't think it gets run at all).  Should the two remaining tests there be removed?  Are they already ported over somewhere else?  I don't see a check_cholesky_factor_corr test in the src/test/unit/math.

Cheers,
Marcus
